ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups in robots.txt for other training crawlers (CCBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, etc.)
ideas.why: The config says to block training crawlers but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the other training crawlers are still allowed.

ideas.idea: Keep search and user-fetch agents (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot) allowed
ideas.why: This describes the current state and adds no new action.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Bakery, Product, Course) on the public pages
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, and the report ranks it as high priority and the 'biggest single lever'.

ideas.idea: Make content more specific: list every loaf with description and price, give class details, and add a visible address and hours block
ideas.why: The pages are vague and have no address, hours, prices or class details, so this gives users and answer engines concrete facts.

ideas.idea: Put the answer in the first sentence of each section so it can be quoted
ideas.why: This is general writing advice that applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice and expand the allergen information
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet is a deliberate scoped choice, and the report itself says to leave it if deliberate.

ideas.idea: Add the missing /img/loaves.jpg file and width/height attributes, and consider lazy loading
ideas.why: index.html references /img/loaves.jpg, which is not in the repo, and the img tag has no dimensions.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata to the public pages
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site, and the pages already have titles and descriptions.
This is accurate but has little effect on a 3-URL site.

ideas.idea: Resolve the conflict between the /members/ robots.txt Disallow and the noindex
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say the noindex plus disallow on /members is correct for a private page.

ideas.idea: Make the homepage title format consistent with 'Page | Brand'
ideas.why: This is a minor stylistic change with very little effect.

ideas.idea: Lengthen and differentiate the breads and classes meta descriptions to 120-155 characters
ideas.why: The length target is folklore, and the descriptions are already adequate and specific.
This applies to almost any site and has little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add contextual internal links, such as from class text to a booking page
ideas.why: The pages are linked only through the nav, and classes.html says to book but gives no link to do so.
The deliberate choices say having no llms.txt is not a problem, and the report concedes the evidence for it is weak.

ideas.idea: Replace the .example placeholder domain with the real origin before launch
ideas.why: This is true of any placeholder domain, and the .example domain is clearly a stand-in.
